patterns.message: cli-messaging speaks no provider: an adapter translates into the domain model, and nothing here may import a messenger library or an adapter
drizzle-orm is a development dependency, bundled into dist at build time: import it through src/store/sqlite/drizzle/ (add what you need to core.ts), or tg and max crash at runtime
src/tasks/ is a module: import it through src/tasks/index.ts or src/tasks/testing/index.ts, and export there what is new
